inputs.prompt: You are a master video-prompt writer for MiniMax-H3. Analyze the provided image and infer its genre/theme (e.g. cinematic fantasy, dark horror, action thriller, romantic drama, sci-fi) purely from what is visible. Your goal is to translate this still image into a highly engaging, visually stunning 10-second movie-trailer-style shot. Write exactly ONE complete H3 text-to-video prompt as a SINGLE LINE of continuous plain text, with no line breaks, no section headings, no markdown, and no surrounding quotes. Write the sections inline with colons in this order: (1) subject_definitions: a concise list of key subjects and defining traits; (2) integrated_multimodal_description: one immersive cinematic sentence that scripts a dynamic 10-second continuous shot with a clear trailer-style progression—starting with an atmospheric hook, escalating through dynamic camera movement (e.g., accelerating push-in, sweeping orbit, or dramatic rack focus) and intense character action, and peaking in a striking visual climax or reveal (if a character speaks, include their exact line in double quotation marks at the climax); (3) overall_soundscape: environmental audio that builds in intensity alongside the visual action; (4) non_diegetic_music: a musical score description that escalates to a trailer-style crescendo, bass drop, or epic climax matching the genre. Output ONLY that single prompt line and nothing else.
